thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — we're proposing a breaking change to the partner SDK response envelope (planning window below). Need triage: impact, canaries, and comms plan. TL;DR: rename top-level "result" -> "response" and remove legacy "metadata.v1" object. This is semver-major for SDKs and marketplace adapters.

alex: Do we have a rough list of who this will touch? Marketplace vendors, installer scripts, and a few SI adapters?

maria: Yep. Top 20 marketplace images, 7 SI integrations we've seen using metadata.v1, and some customers pinning adapter versions. I'll attach a matrix in the doc.

danielle: Can we provide a temporary compatibility flag (ENV var or header) that returns legacy envelope for 6 weeks? That'd buy time for partners.

leo: Engineering can ship a runtime fallback in Dedicated & Hosted for a short grace window, but marketplace packages need new releases. Fallback adds 5-10% token overhead during parsing.

alex: Proposed stoplight for partners: green = no change, yellow = patch needed (minor bump), red = major action (adapter rebuild). We should populate matrix and prioritize red partners for outreach.

maria: Proposed schedule: announce (week 0), SDK polyfills & migration guide (week 1), partner patches & canaries (week 2-5), deprecation notice (week 6), removal (week 12). Thoughts?

danielle: Fine but request we move deprecation notice to week 8 — partners asked for a longer runway. Also recommend a staggered removal: marketplace first, then SI.

leo: Agree with stagger. We'll gate removal on canary metrics (errors <= 0.5% and 95p latency < baseline+20%). I'll add those thresholds to the runbook.

alex: I'll draft a migration guide + sample adapter diff. Quick snippet we can surface in docs:
```json
{
  "response": { "text": "..." },
  "trace_id": "..."
}
```
and a note: old body.response => new.response, drop metadata.v1.* fields.

partner-bot: Scheduled: compatibility-runbook draft created -> https://console.redwood.com/partners/compat-runway (private). Auto-tagged: #compatibility #marketplace #si

maria: Action items: @alex draft migration doc by EOD Tue, @danielle top-10 partner outreach + FAQ by Wed, @leo implement runtime fallback and canary metrics by Thu. I'll follow up with announcement copy once drafts land. Use the stoplight matrix in the doc to set priority. :thumbsup:

danielle: On it — I'll also ask support to open priority tickets for red partners so we can track fixes.

alex: Draft uploading in ~3hrs. Will include sample npm/pip release commands and a tiny shim they can vendor.

maria: Thanks all — let's meet Fri 10am to review canary criteria & comms. If you find any partner already hard-pinned to metadata.v1, ping me immediately.

leo: noted.

partner-bot: Reminder set for Fri 10:00.
